I pirated it at first, an my school of thought was, "I'm gonna play it a little and if I like it, I'm gonna buy it when it goes on sale."

In this case, I just bought it yesterday, because I "accidentally" got like 55% through the story mode. This game is incredibly fun. I got lost in multiplayer last night, the missions, no matter how mundane, are insanely fun. The heists are crazy satisfying. Yes, it's worth every penny.

My take on it as a solo player:

The singleplayer stuff is definitely worth it. It's an amazing world with impressive physics for the most part, everything's responsive. Story and missions are lots of fun, they definitely give you plenty of stuff to do. If you have any interest in the singleplayer, it's worth the buy.

Multiplayer is.. a little meh, in my mind. The 'city as a lobby' gets old pretty quick, because most encounters with other players end up being shoot on sight. They have a nice passive mode that keeps you out of combat if that's your thing, but then you have little to do. The games/missions you can play are fun, but often repetitious.

Online Heists. When everything goes right, they're a lot of fun. But that's.. maybe 10-20% of the time. Most Heists and Setups i've been in have one person who is under-leveled or under skilled for the job, and any time they fail or die EVERYONE IN THE HEIST STARTS OVER. After a couple restarts, one person quits, and that completely scraps it and forces the leader to host a whole new heist and try again. This is, to put it mildly, less than fun. After I completed all the heists and bought the cars I wanted I found that GTA online lost all appeal pretty quick. If I had friends to mess around in it, that would be a different story I expect.

My girlfriend is playing on her Lenovo laptop. It has: i5 @ 2.something GHz, Intel HD Graphics 4000 (integrated), 6gb RAM

She lags sometimes when there's a lot of traffic, but otherwise she plays fine. You can place a commandline.txt in the games root directory to specify the level of detail you want in the game.

In hers I have:

-DX10_1
-borderless
-windowed
-height 768
-width 1366
-useMinimumSettings

See here: https://support.rockstargames.com/hc/en-us/articles/202518358-Available-Command-Lines-for-GTAV-on-PC
